integrity: Seven-parameter derivation normal form verified by the Leibniz constraints. The exact finite-field rank counts and proof are supplied.
scientific_limitations: Only the four-dimensional model filiform Lie algebra is classified; no claim for arbitrary filiform deformations.
Equivalent old finite-field enumerations may exist under different terminology.
The proof is symbolic; finite enumeration covers field sizes 2, 3, 4, 5 only.
title: Finite-field derivation-rank spectra and the invertibility threshold for the four-dimensional model filiform Lie algebra
